notes: built via adapter; script is Y-up so sketch('front') rect revolved 360 gives a tube whose axis is world Y (FreeCAD Z maps to our Y, FreeCAD Y to our -Z or Z); volume = pi*(20^2-10^2)*30 = 28274.33 exact; 4 faces; mesh non-empty
scriptSource: const sk = sketch('front'); sk.rect(10, 30, { at: [15, 15] }); revolve(sk, 360);
